title: 2014 AMC 12A Problem 5
statement: On an algebra quiz, \(10\%\) of the students scored \(70\) points, \(35\%\) scored \(80\) points, \(30\%\) scored \(90\) points, and the rest scored \(100\) points. What is the difference between the mean and the median of the students’ scores on this quiz?

solutions.text:
The remaining \(25\%\) scored \(100.\) Since \(45\%\) scored at most \(80\) and \(75\%\) scored at most \(90,\) the median is \(90.\)

The mean is \[ \begin{aligned} &0.10(70)+0.35(80)\\ &\quad{}+0.30(90)+0.25(100)\\ &\quad{}=7+28+27+25=87. \end{aligned} \]

The difference is \(90-87=3.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: The median is the score of the middle student after ordering everyone
